preconditions.description: The number of distinct scores m must be between 1 and 31.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= ai <= 30 for ai in S)
preconditions.description: Each score in the set S must be between 0 and 30.
The set S must contain exactly m distinct integers.

postconditions.description: If no tournament can be formed with the given scores, output '=('.
The number of vertices n in the tournament must be at least the number of distinct scores m.

postconditions.expression: all(len(row) == n for row in tournament_matrix)
postconditions.description: Each row in the tournament matrix must have exactly n characters.

postconditions.expression: all(row[i] == '0' for i in range(n) for row in tournament_matrix)
postconditions.description: The main diagonal of the tournament matrix must contain only zeros.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(row) == d for row, d in zip(tournament_matrix, sorted(S)))
postconditions.description: The sum of each row in the tournament matrix must match the corresponding score in the sorted set S.
